captureProvenance.note: Original CPU results are returned unchanged. Inputs and expected values are copied from actual calls; scalar captures include cache misses only. No generated/duplicated hypotheses. Capture timings include observation overhead and are not speed evidence.

note: Recorded calls from a real CPU filter prefix, without hypothesis replication. Original NumPy _loglik_batch method bodies are compiled unchanged from the pinned source; cached design and packed arrays are prepared before clocks. Scalar-weight captures validate against original scalar outputs but CPU timings use the existing batched method, not the scalar proposal loop. CUDA durations include all uploads, fused FP64 evaluation, all output readback and stream synchronization. Imports/JIT, packing, parity, output checks and serialization are excluded. Shared warm workspace; alternating policies; no live graph, proposal generation, RNG, resampling, FIX decisions, ensemble coordination or full positioning speedup is measured.
